brief.subject: Bills due before payday? Ask to move the date
brief.headline: Bills Due Before Payday? Asking to Shift Due Dates Can Help
brief.dek: Moving bill due dates can smooth cash flow, and the FTC sues to stop a playground equipment merger over price concerns.
brief.lede: If your bills come due before your paycheck lands, asking billers for a new due date can ease the squeeze.

sections.heading: Fix the payday timing gap
bullets: Changing a bill's due date is an option worth requesting when payments arrive before payday.
Lining up due dates with your pay schedule can make monthly cash flow easier to manage.
The tip came in response to a common reader question about bills landing ahead of paychecks.

sections.heading: FTC moves to block merger
bullets: The FTC sued to stop PlayPower, owned by Platinum Equity, from buying rival playground maker BCI Burke.
The agency says the two are among the largest makers of commercial outdoor playground equipment.
Regulators argue the deal would weaken competition on price and quality in an already concentrated market.
